name: Skeet
description:
Touchscreen dictation for Wayland. A floating parrot button: tap it, talk, tap again, and the text is typed where your cursor is. Offline speech recognition (NVIDIA Parakeet via sherpa-onnx) with a live caption, a background noise filter, and Delete and Enter buttons after each dictation.

Needs a one-time setup of the speech engine, a model download and ydotool; open the extension's settings.
